concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a polished high-fidelity landscape UI concept image for the existing Chinese PICO headset app "L's VR Player", continuing the selected A "深色影院" visual language. The supplied A image is a STYLE REFERENCE only, not an edit target: match its matte ink-blue #10161D / raised #1A242E surfaces, restrained seafoam #62D5C7 accent, high-contrast #F2F6F7 text, legible #B0BAC6 secondary text, rounded windows with smaller control corners, refined Chinese sans-serif typography and coherent outline icons. Prefer flat readable matte surfaces rather than glossy effects. Straight front-on view, no perspective distortion or VR lens mask. Original artwork and fictional demo data only, no people/photos of real people, private account information, real network addresses, browser chrome, marketing decoration, neon, tiny paragraphs or watermark. Generous controller-ray targets and clearly spaced controls. These are UI review concepts, not a website.
Primary request: Re-design ONLY the quick playback interface to honor the user's precise interaction design. Image 2, the existing QuickPanelClose screenshot, is the LAYOUT AND BEHAVIOR REFERENCE. It defines a wide horizontal control panel and a separate circular X floating beneath its horizontal center. Modernize its visual treatment using image 1's A palette while retaining that structure.
Composition: two large wide bars stacked vertically with generous separation, representing two alternative states of the same UI. Each bar has its OWN distinct round X button floating BELOW its center with clearly visible dark-space gap. A tiny external label "常态" above the first and "跳转预览" above the second is allowed solely as a design-board annotation, OUTSIDE the interface. No enclosing titled container around either bar. Never put "快捷播放" or any page heading or brand inside or on these control bars. No artwork, no movie poster, no thumbnail, no decorative material image.
CRITICAL WHOLE-BAR PROGRESS DESIGN: the bar's entire rectangular background, BOTH upper and lower halves, is the progress indicator. Exactly the left 30% of each entire rounded panel is tinted soft seafoam/dark teal and the remaining 70% is matte ink blue. A clear vertical color boundary at 30% communicates the current playback position. The full-height tinted background runs BEHIND the controls. There is NO thin seek rail, NO progress line, NO conventional slider, NO seek thumb or separate timeline widget anywhere in either bar.
Upper half of each bar is a large clear CONTINUOUS seek hit area, not chopped into cards. It displays only elapsed time "32:18" left, filename "静海.mp4" center and duration "1:48:06" right. Keep generous blank upper-half space around these labels for precise ray pointing.
Lower half: seven icon controls spread horizontally with ample targets. At far left subtitles and volume; the centered symmetric transport cluster MUST be previous / large circular pause / next in exactly that order, located around the bar's geometric horizontal center; far right format and speed. Use icons only in normal state, no captions beneath icons. Previous and next have matching visual weight; central pause is larger. Controls do not intercept the upper blank seek area. Do not introduce an inline stop or return button. The only stop control is the standalone floating circular X below. The X has no permanent label.
Second (seek-hover) state repeats exactly the same 30% background fill and same button arrangement. A small ray pointer contact sits in the upper half at 65% of total width, and a thin VERTICAL preview marker rises above the bar to a readable small badge "1:10:16". This marker is target preview only; the actual full-height 30% background fill stays unchanged until commit. No horizontal line or slider. The preview badge sits close above the point and does not obscure filename. No extra diagram arrows or tutorial prose. The two controls are alternative states, not simultaneous UI.
Make bars substantial in height, approximately 5.8:1 aspect ratio, filling most canvas width. Preserve large target areas and a close button clear of the progress rectangle. Render clean, convincing practical VR UI with A's premium restrained quality.

This is information architecture for real file browsing, highlighting content space, navigation history vs parent and recoverable states.
